data.name: Bogusław
data.gender_notes: Bogusław is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Old Polish word ‘Bog’, meaning ‘God’, and ‘slaw’, meaning ‘glory’ or ‘fame’. The name Bogusław honors God and signifies the glory or fame that comes from a life devoted to Him. The name Bogusław carries the meaning “God's glory” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Bogusław usually hope their child will grow to embody god's glory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes devotion to God and the spiritual rewards that come from living a virtuous life.
data.etymology: Bogusław belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's glory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bogusław total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Bogusław is an ancient Polish name that dates back to the Middle Ages, making it a rich part of Poland's cultural heritage. It was popular among the Slavic elite and royalty, who saw their power and prestige as deriving from God. The name reflects a deep connection to historical Polish traditions and values, and it continues to be cherished by many Poles today.
data.spiritual_significance: Bogusław is a deeply spiritual name, rooted in the reverence for God that is a fundamental tenet of the Christian faith. The name reflects a commitment to living a godly life and seeking God's glory and fame above all else. It is a reminder of the ultimate purpose and source of all true power and success, and a call to strive for a deep and meaningful relationship with God. By bearing the name Bogusław, one is making a public declaration of their faith and devotion to God, and aspiring to live a life that brings honor and glory to Him.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Bogusław, meaning "glory of God" in Polish, reflects the deep spiritual connection between the individual and the divine. It serves as a constant reminder of the ultimate purpose of human existence: to give praise and honor to God.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Bogusław was a Duke in Poland in the 14th century. The name Bogusław carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Bogusław is of Slavic origin and is composed of the elements 'Bogu' meaning 'God' and 'Slav' meaning 'glory'. It is a rare name in modern times and is not commonly used outside of Poland and other Slavic countries. In the gaming world, Bogusław is the name of a character in the Witcher 3: Wild Hunt, a popular action role-playing game.
